title: Regression Beacon: composite eval gating and shadow illumination for canary traffic
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a lightweight, production-safe ‘Regression Beacon’ service that evaluates incoming canary and shadowed responses against configured golden prompt scorecards and emits a single composite health signal used by the Rollout Conductor. The goal is to reduce noisy alerts and false positives while enabling automatic quarantine/rollback for severe regressions. This ticket covers the scoring model, sampling plan, integration points (Console dashboards, Rollout Conductor, PagerDuty/SRE), and a small simulator for threshold tuning.
acceptance_criteria: Composite health score computed per-model-per-canary-window and emitted to rollout conductor every 10s
Support attaching 1..n golden prompt sets with per-prompt weights and metric types (semantic-similarity, BLEU-like token overlap, volatility)
Statistical badge for significance (bootstrap-based confidence intervals) shown in Console when composite delta > configured threshold
Auto-quarantine rule in Rollout Conductor triggers when composite score drops by >10% with p < 0.01 and sustained for 3 consecutive windows
Shadow traffic pipeline tags responses and correlates them to customer cohorts; no plaintext customer data persisted in golden store
Simulator (local) that replays historical canary/shadow traffic to validate thresholds and compute expected false positive rate
implementation_steps: Define composite scoring schema: normalize metric families and compute weighted sum with optional non-linear penalties
Implement per-prompt weighting and golden-set metadata schema in eval-store (read-only for Regression Beacon)
Build light-weight streaming scorer that subscribes to shadow/canary Kafka topic and emits per-window metrics to Metrics API
Add bootstrap CI that computes confidence intervals for delta between baseline and candidate models per-window
Integrate with Rollout Conductor API: health -> OK / WARN / FAIL plus metadata for auto-action
Add Console UI panel for Regression Beacon: composite curve, per-prompt outliers, and download link for failing samples
Create simulator harness and run against last 6 months of shadow runs to propose default thresholds
decisions: Use bootstrap-based confidence intervals instead of parametric z-tests because metric distributions are heavy-tailed for long-token outputs

Composite score will include three families: correctness (semantic similarity), stability (generation variance across seeds/context), and safety (policy classifier regression). Each family normalizes to 0..1
Default auto-quarantine threshold chosen conservatively (10% composite drop + p < 0.01 + 3 windows) to limit rollbacks from transient noise
Shadow traffic sampling will be rate-limited per-customer with priority given to customers in Dedicated tier to avoid billing surprises
Do not persist raw customer inputs in golden prompt store; use hashed IDs and salted indices to allow incident reconstruction while preserving PII constraints

2026-02-20: prototype scorer implemented in Rust worker; validates against local gold set and emits metrics to dev-metrics namespace
2026-02-28: initial simulator run against archived shadow logs shows ~1.8% expected false positive rate at conservative thresholds
2026-03-05: security review notes gating on KMS access for golden-store; added encryption-at-rest checklist
2026-03-10: design review with SRE - recommended adding 2-minute hysteresis and fallback to next-best model variant instead of immediate rollback; added to decisions
2026-03-12: integration PR opened (github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-conductor/pull/412) for health signal API shape
review_feedback: PM (L. Rivera): prefer more granular alerts (per-cohort) in Console before auto-quarantine for high-value customers
Design (A. Som): add an explanation panel that surfaces top-3 prompts driving the regression to help triage
SRE (R. Gomez): ensure scorer worker has memory/cpu limits and circuit-breaker to avoid cascading failures
Security (J. Park): require KMS-backed access for golden-set uploads and forbid cross-customer golden sharing
open_questions: What is the retention policy for per-prompt failure artifacts when investigating quarantines?
Should cohort-level thresholds be auto-tuned based on historical variance or remain static per-release?
How do we present multi-metric tradeoffs when correctness improves but stability degrades?
follow_up_tasks: Add cohort-aware threshold autoscaling MVP (follow-up ENG ticket)
Instrument per-prompt explainability hook in scorer and wire to Console download
Run staged internal canary with human-in-the-loop for 2 releases to validate thresholds
Create runbook for SRE and support for interpreting composite scores and initiating manual rollbacks
notes: Primary trade-off: sensitivity vs. availability. We intentionally bias toward availability for general customers while enabling aggressive auto-actions for Dedicated tenants with contract-backed SLAs. Current prototype is in dev; next week will focus on Circuit Breaker hardening and Console visuals. Contact Maya or Ethan for demo requests.
simulator_results_summary: Simulator replayed 1.2M shadowed requests from Nov 2025 - Apr 2026; expected quarantine incidence ~0.9% per-release under current thresholds; most noise traced to long-context multi-turn prompts
next_milestone: Public beta behind feature flag for 2 non-production customers by 2026-03-28
